bigquery_dataset.Description: Shared dataset i.e. BigQuery dataset source.

dataset.Description: Resource name of the dataset source for this listing. e.g. projects/myproject/datasets/123

categories.Description: Categories of the listing. Up to two categories are allowed.

data_exchange_id.Description: The ID of the data exchange. Must contain only Unicode letters, numbers (0-9), underscores (_). Should not use characters that require URL-escaping, or characters outside of ASCII, spaces.

data_provider.Description: Details of the data provider who owns the source data.

primary_contact.Description: Email or URL of the data provider.

description.Description: Short description of the listing. The description must not contain Unicode non-characters and C0 and C1 control codes except tabs (HT), new lines (LF), carriage returns (CR), and page breaks (FF).

display_name.Description: Human-readable display name of the listing. The display name must contain only Unicode letters, numbers (0-9), underscores (_), dashes (-), spaces ( ), ampersands (&) and can't start or end with spaces.

icon.Description: Base64 encoded image representing the listing.

listing_id.Description: The ID of the listing. Must contain only Unicode letters, numbers (0-9), underscores (_). Should not use characters that require URL-escaping, or characters outside of ASCII, spaces.

location.Description: The name of the location this data exchange listing.

name.Description: The resource name of the listing. e.g. "projects/myproject/locations/US/dataExchanges/123/listings/456"

primary_contact.Description: Email or URL of the primary point of contact of the listing.

publisher.Description: Details of the publisher who owns the listing and who can share the source data.

primary_contact.Description: Email or URL of the listing publisher.

request_access.Description: Email or URL of the request access of the listing. Subscribers can use this reference to request access.

restricted_export_config.Description: If set, restricted export configuration will be propagated and enforced on the linked dataset.

restrict_query_result.Description: If true, restrict export of query result derived from restricted linked dataset table.
